note: Machine-readable constants about this athlete. tools/brief.py prints these every session so nothing has to be remembered. Prose reasoning lives in profile/patterns.md.

injuries: ACL reconstruction 5-6 years ago, rehabbed, no current pain
athlete.goal: maximum muscle, size > strength > leanness, 12 months

units.reports_portions_as: bowls and fractions of bowls, not grams
units.pull_up_load: added kg on top of bodyweight

progression.working_load: heaviest load handled last time, counting any set within 2 reps of the range - never the last set, he ramps down when tired
progression.add_load_when: every set at the top of the rep range
progression.squat_and_trapbar: +2.5 kg every session while technique holds
progression.last_set_isolation: to failure, never to a round number

eating.bottleneck: stomach volume on carbs, not protein - he can eat 350 g of meat but not 2 bags of rice
eating.standard_snack: bowl of skyr + 2 tbsp peanut butter + 2 tbsp honey + blueberries + a glass of juice = 785 kcal, 53 g protein
